summary: Ten metres of kerb across a car park entrance on a through road.
reasons: Short stretch at a car park entrance
Through road, no kerbside parking seen
Narrow verge, no room off lane

drivers.seclusion: Treed golf course bank behind; homes 25 m or more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Stretch is the mouth of the car park driveway; a van would block it.
drivers.traffic: Through road with lane markings and overhead lines; no cars on this kerb.
drivers.convention: No kerbside parking seen; golf cars use the off-road lot next to it.

sun_shade: Trees to the south and east shade the verge; open to the north.

best_section.where: Short kerb stretch by the golf car park entrance on Carawa Street
